nodes.description: Constant state variable NUM_TRAITS = 9, bounds the trait arrays and loops in roll().
Constant state variable MAX_LENGTH = 40, bounds the gene tables and inner loop in roll().
External view function roll(uint seed, uint nonce) that derives pseudo-random traits from block.difficulty, seed, block.timestamp and nonce.
Caller-supplied seed parameter used as keccak256 entropy input.
Caller-supplied nonce parameter used as keccak256 entropy input.
Local uint[NUM_TRAITS] array holding the rolled traits and returned by roll().
Local 4x40x9 cumulative gene probability table used to map traitSeed to trait values.
Local 2x2 race threshold table used to select the race trait.
Local pseudo-random seed computed via keccak256(block.difficulty, seed, block.timestamp, nonce++).
Local race index selected by comparing randomSeed against race thresholds.
Loop index used over races and NUM_TRAITS loops.
Local modulo-derived seed used to index the gene probability tables.
Inner loop index over MAX_LENGTH gene table entries.
Miner/validator-controlled block timestamp used as entropy in the pseudo-random seed.
Pseudo-random seed generation via keccak256(block.difficulty, seed, block.timestamp, nonce++), a timestamp-dependent and predictably influenceable randomness source.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is fed directly into the keccak256 pseudo-random seed generation, creating timestamp dependency.
roll() unconditionally performs the timestamp-dependent random seed generation, so all trait outcomes depend on the block timestamp.
Local randomSeed is assigned from the unsafe keccak256 seed generation.
roll() consumes the seed parameter as entropy input.
roll() consumes the nonce parameter as entropy input.
seed is packed into the keccak256 computation that produces randomSeed.
nonce is packed into the keccak256 computation that produces randomSeed.
NUM_TRAITS determines the size of traits and the outer loop bound in roll().
MAX_LENGTH determines the size of the gene tables and the inner loop bound in roll().
traitSeed is derived by modulo of randomSeed against the gene conversion table.
traitSeed selects the entry written into the traits array.
Selected race index r writes races[0][r] into traits[0].
genes table entries determine the trait values assigned into traits.
races table thresholds determine the race value assigned into traits[0].
traits is returned by roll() and post-processed by the trait override conditionals.
Loop index i drives the race and trait generation loops inside roll().
Inner loop index j drives the gene table scan inside roll().

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter seed is only meaningful as an input to the roll() function and should be absorbed into the function node.
Parameter nonce is only meaningful as an input to the roll() function and should be absorbed into the function node.
Local traits is the return buffer of roll() and is defined solely by that function.
Local genes table is a constant lookup structure used only inside roll().
Local races table is a constant lookup structure used only inside roll().
Local randomSeed exists only as the result of the unsafe seed generation operation.
Local r is a race index used only within roll()'s trait selection logic.
Local loop index i is a control artifact of roll() and has no independent meaning.
Local traitSeed is an intermediate derived value used only inside roll().
Local loop index j is a control artifact of roll() and has no independent meaning.
